title: Docs for DAW set export: tools, concepts, glossary, design note
description:
## Intent

Document the export for users and keep the design note current.

## Steps

- `docs/tools.md`: `apricity export --daw-set` with its flags, next to `apricity render`.
- `docs/concepts.md`: a section "Taking a score into a DAW": what the set holds (tracks, warped clips, locators, collected samples), what it doesn't yet, and that the DAW's warp algorithms differ from Rubber Band, so the sound is close but not identical.
- `docs/glossary.md`: entries for **DAW set**, **locator**, **collect** (samples copied beside a set).
- `design/daw-set.md`: mark the M1 rows of the mapping table as built. `design/vocabulary.md`: add a word only if one is introduced.
- Never write the vendor's name; say "the DAW".

## Verification

the diff adds no mention of the vendor's name or the DAW's product name (the project's naming rule); the web app's Docs tab renders the pages (`npm --prefix web run build`).

## Release

`docs(<this task's id>): export a score as a DAW set`.
